title: EEG study of the attentional blink; before, during, and after transcranial Direct Current Stimulation (tDCS)
description: EEG recordings from participants performing an attentional blink task before, during, and after transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS). Each participant visited the lab twice, receiving anodal or cathodal stimulation over F3 with a return electrode over the right forehead, with complete data for 40 participants. The dataset supports study of concurrent tDCS-EEG artifacts and of stimulation effects on attentional blink event-related responses.
methods_description: Each of two visits, about one week apart, included three ~20-minute EEG recordings: pre-tDCS, during tDCS, and post-tDCS. tDCS was delivered at 1 mA for 20 minutes with 1-minute ramp-up and ramp-down, using 7x5 cm rubber electrodes over F3 and right forehead (Fp2). Data were recorded in BioSemi BDF format and converted to BrainVision format using FieldTrip. Channels blocked by the tDCS electrodes are marked as bad in the channels files.
